name: B
purpose: independent validation set; no optimizer input builder reads this file, and its texts never appear under <lineage>/experiments/
note: Five drafted questions (from the v4.1 package, not from the question bank, so none of them was ever judged in rounds 1-12). After each PASS one question rotates out to `retired` and the runner draws the next id of the same category from `pool`; pool entries without `text` are loaded from the question bank by id. Refresh the whole set after `validation.maxUsesBeforeRefresh` uses.

questions.text: I work rotating shifts and keep abandoning exercise plans because my schedule changes every week. What would a realistic approach look like?

I have six months of living expenses saved and want to try freelancing. My employer allows part-time work, but the lower salary would leave little room to save. How should I compare going part-time with leaving completely?

My partner wants us to move closer to their family. I would lose the friends and community I have built here. We both have jobs we can do remotely. How do we discuss this without treating one person’s needs as more important?
I achieved a career goal I worked toward for years, but it feels less satisfying than I expected. How can I work out whether I need a new direction or simply time to adjust?
When a novel gives two characters incompatible accounts of the same event, how can I distinguish an unreliable narrator from an intentionally unresolved truth?
